drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Our client is still finalizing its authorized settlement figure, so we are not proposing an amount in this draft. As a proposed timetable, payment would be due within 10 business days after execution of the agreement. We have revised the release to become effective only upon receipt of cleared funds and added customary confidentiality exceptions for legal, tax, and enforcement purposes. We will follow up regarding the amount.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Settlement Amount, as agreed by the parties in a writing signed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds within 10 business days after execution of this Agreement.
2. RELEASE. Upon the Plaintiff's receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, the Plaintiff releases the Defendant from all claims resolved by this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, tax advisers, auditors, insurers, or other professional advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; as required by law, regulation, or court order; for tax reporting or advice; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party required to disclose shall, where legally permitted, provide prior notice to the other party.
